items.why: The report says "every line about 2.5 cm-1 higher on day 2" (E2g1 +2.50, A1g +2.43) and that the "separation is also unchanged" (21.56 → 21.47 cm-1).
The report says "the Si 520.7 cm-1 line moved by the same amount (519.98 → 522.47 cm-1), so this is a spectrometer calibration drift, not a property of the flake."

After Si correction, the report says "E2g1 and A1g agree within 0.02 and 0.07 cm-1" within the combined uncertainty, and that the flake is "about 2L (E–A separation 21.5 cm-1)" against the 2L reference of 21.4 cm-1.

The report says "A1g-only broadening (which would indicate doping) is absent, and so is any E2g1 broadening or splitting (which would indicate strain)" and gives unchanged FWHMs; it also cites A1g softening with doping and E' softening with strain.
The report asks "Was the spectrometer recalibrated, re-aligned, or the grating changed between the two days?" and whether a "Si or neon/Hg reference spectrum" was recorded with each spectrum.

wrong_claims.why: The report rejects strain and doping, stating "The data give no sign of adsorbate doping or strain."
The report gives 2L on both days and "no measurable change," with no LA(M) defect band on either day.
